name: Music Organizer
author: nd-organizer
description: Organizes your Navidrome library: classifies albums (Soundtrack > Various Artist > Singles > Normal) and renames folders/files to your schemas, preserving live/bootleg recordings. Refreshes tags + artwork from MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, iTunes and Last.fm; reads/writes Kodi NFO sidecars; verifies identity (AcoustID fingerprint + tags + names) before writing. Integrates with Lidarr (metadata, naming schema, force-search incomplete albums) and AudioMuse-AI (acoustic tags, re-sync). Dry-run default, change history with rollback, metadata backups, reports + status feed (log webhook). Runs in idle-only batches and rescans Navidrome after moves so playback never hits stale files.

library.reason: Read, tag and rename music files inside library folders. Write access must be granted via the CLI (navidrome plugin edit nd-organizer --write-access).

http.reason: Fetch metadata/artwork from MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, iTunes, Last.fm, AcoustID, Lidarr and AudioMuse-AI. Wildcard required for user-configured Lidarr/AudioMuse URLs.

taskqueue.reason: Process one album per background task (callbacks are time-limited).

scheduler.reason: Run the organizer on a schedule and on startup.

subsonicapi.reason: Trigger Navidrome rescans (startScan) after path changes so the player never streams stale filenames.

users.reason: Resolve the scan user for startScan.

kvstore.reason: Cache external metadata responses and audio fingerprints.

cache.reason: Session cache for external metadata lookups.

storage.reason: Write run reports and persistent state.

mode.title: Run mode (dry run / apply)
mode.description: dryRun plans and reports everything without changing a file. Switch to apply once you've reviewed a dry-run report.

runOnStartup.title: Run on plugin start
runOnStartup.description: Run the organizer once when the plugin starts (~15s after load). If a scheduleCron is set, it then runs on that schedule as well; if the cron is empty, this startup run is the only automatic run.

scheduleCron.title: Run schedule (cron)
scheduleCron.description: Cron expression for recurring runs, e.g. "0 3 * * 1" (weekly). Empty disables recurring runs - then only the 'Run on plugin start' run (if enabled) runs automatically.

maxAlbumsPerRun.title: Max albums per run
maxAlbumsPerRun.description: How many albums to consider in one scheduled pass.

albumsPerTask.title: Albums per task (batch size)
albumsPerTask.description: Each background task plans a small batch of album groups, keeping resource use low so playback is never impacted.

filesPerScanTask.title: Files scanned per task
filesPerScanTask.description: The full-library scan reads a small chunk of files' tags per background task. Lower values are slower but lighter on resources; scanning is thorough by design.

runOnlyWhenIdle.title: Only run when nothing is playing
runOnlyWhenIdle.description: Only run when nothing is playing; if playback is active, the run waits and retries automatically.

rollbackRunId.title: Rollback run ID
rollbackRunId.description: Set to a run ID (from the log, e.g. run-1755000000) to undo that run's changes on the next pass: restore backup metadata, rename files back, move folders back. Clear it afterwards. Runs are idempotent - already-rolled-back runs are skipped.

logWebhookUrl.title: Log webhook URL
logWebhookUrl.description: Optional. URL of the nd-organizer webhook dashboard sidecar (e.g. http://nd-organizer-webhook:8099 on the shared Docker network). Each run's report and status are POSTed here as plain text - use a hosted log/notifier (ntfy, Gotify, Discord webhook, Loki push endpoint, ...) if you prefer. The plugin settings UI cannot render links; open this service's own dashboard/URL to view the log.

logWebhookToken.title: Log webhook token
logWebhookToken.description: Optional token sent as X-Token and Authorization: Bearer headers.

persistenceBackend.title: Persistence backend
persistenceBackend.description: Where the plugin keeps its cache/state (scan index, task log, stats, caches). 'host' = the Navidrome-managed SQLite KVStore. 'mysql' = your own database via the mysql sidecar (mysql/docker-compose.yml), so plugin state survives plugin resets.

persistenceUrl.title: MySQL sidecar URL
persistenceUrl.description: URL of the mysql sidecar (e.g. http://nd-organizer-mysql:8098). Required when persistenceBackend = mysql.

mysqlHost.title: MySQL host
mysqlHost.description: Hostname/IP of your MySQL or MariaDB server.

mysqlPort.title: MySQL port
mysqlPort.description: Port your MySQL or MariaDB server listens on (usually 3306).

mysqlName.title: MySQL database name
mysqlName.description: Database that will hold the plugin's kvstore table (created automatically).

mysqlUser.title: MySQL user
mysqlUser.description: A MySQL user with read/write access to the database above.

mysqlPassword.title: MySQL password
mysqlPassword.description: Credentials are sent only to the mysql sidecar over the internal Docker network.

soundtrackFolder.title: Soundtrack folder
soundtrackFolder.description: Folder name for soundtrack albums when 'Nest soundtracks under Various Artist' is off.

variousFolder.title: Various artist folder
variousFolder.description: Folder name used for various-artist / compilation albums.

singlesFolder.title: Singles folder
singlesFolder.description: Folder name for single tracks and incomplete albums.

nestBucketsUnderVarious.title: Nest soundtracks under Various Artist
nestBucketsUnderVarious.description: Soundtracks go under Various Artist/Sound Tracks/... when on, or as a top-level Sound Tracks/ folder when off. (Singles are not affected - they always go under the single's artist per the 'Put singles under the artist' option.)

singlesUnderArtist.title: Put singles under the artist's folder
singlesUnderArtist.description: Artist/Singles/{title} instead of the Various Artist singles area. Falls back to Various Artist/Singles when the artist is unknown.

singlesEnabled.title: Enable singles / incomplete-album routing
singlesEnabled.description: Route single-track and incomplete albums (below the min-tracks threshold) to the Singles folder. Off = every album stays in its own album folder.

preserveRecordingType.title: Preserve live/bootleg recording type
preserveRecordingType.description: Detect live/bootleg tracks from tags (LIVE/BOOTLEG, genre, title markers) and suffix files/folders with (Live)/(Bootleg) so they never collide with or get confused as the studio release.

fillerKeywords.title: Filler keywords
fillerKeywords.description: Comma-separated keywords. A track whose title matches one (whole-word) is ignored from the queue: the filter proxy drops it from auto-play lists (random/search/playlist/genre/top/similar). Albums stay whole - it remains in its album, and files are never moved.

playbackStatsEnabled.title: Track playback stats (plays vs skips)
playbackStatsEnabled.description: Tracks full plays and skips (observed via getNowPlaying transitions; works on older Navidrome with no scrobbleretriever host), then builds a 'Top Picks' Navidrome playlist of the highest-weight songs. A full play forgives a skip.

statsPollMinutes.title: Stats poll interval (minutes)
statsPollMinutes.description: How often the plugin updates play/skip stats.

skipThresholdPercent.title: Skip: played less than this % of the song
skipThresholdPercent.description: A track that stops playing before this percentage of its duration counts as a skip - this feeds both the skip-heavy limiter and the star-rating system.

topPicksCount.title: Top Picks playlist size
topPicksCount.description: Number of highest-weight songs to put in the 'nd-organizer: Top Picks' playlist.

keywordFilterEnabled.title: Keyword filter (drop filler tracks from auto-queues)
keywordFilterEnabled.description: Drop filler-keyword tracks (see fillerKeywords) from auto-queues (random/playlist/similar/genre/top/starred) via the filter proxy. Explicit user searches still return them. No files are moved.

skipContentMode.title: Limit skip-heavy content in queues
skipContentMode.description: How much skip-heavy content may appear in queued lists: 'none' keeps everything (just weight-sorted); 'exclude' removes it entirely; 'third' / 'lessThanHalf' (default) / 'half' cap the fraction. A song counts as skip-heavy when you've skipped it more often than you've ever played it in full (after a few listens).

skipHeavyRatio.title: How often a song must be skipped to be 'skip-heavy'
skipHeavyRatio.description: A song becomes 'skip-heavy' (the type limited in your queues) when it meets a clear threshold: after at least 3 interactions, skips make up this fraction or more and you have skipped it more times than you have ever played it in full. 0.6 = skipped 60%+ of the time, and skipped more often than fully played. If you start listening to it fully again, earlier skips are forgiven and the flag clears automatically.

filterUrl.title: Navidrome filter proxy URL
filterUrl.description: Base URL of the nd-organizer filter proxy (e.g. http://nd-organizer-proxy:4534). The proxy drops filler-keyword tracks from auto-queues and limits skip-heavy content in queues according to your settings.

starTallyEnabled.title: Enable star rating + playcount tracking
starTallyEnabled.description: Observes each listen's playback percentage and derives a 0-5 star rating (half-star steps). Rating is kept in the plugin's own storage (use persistenceBackend=mysql for durable external storage) and published to Navidrome's native rating via setRating. Never writes to the audio file.

starHalfPlayPercent.title: Half star: played at least this %
starHalfPlayPercent.description: A listen that reaches at least this % of the track earns a half star (+0.5). Below it, the listen counts as a skip and is a -0.5 penalty.

starFullPlayPercent.title: Full star: played at least this %
starFullPlayPercent.description: A listen that reaches at least this % of the track earns a full star (+1.0) and +1 playcount, and forgives one earlier skip.

starMinSamples.title: Minimum listens before rating publishes
starMinSamples.description: A rating is only written to Navidrome once a track has at least this many listens - prevents a single play from assigning a rating..

lastfmScrobble.title: Scrobble full plays to Last.fm
lastfmScrobble.description: Scrobble full listens (>= starFullPlayPercent) to Last.fm so its playcount grows. DUPLICATE WARNING: if Navidrome's own Last.fm scrobbler or a player scrobbler is also running, plays will be double-counted. Disable Navidrome's built-in Last.fm scrobbler before enabling this. RECOMMENDATION: enable BOTH lastfmScrobble AND listenbrainzScrobble for full coverage across both platforms. For deduplication across multiple sources, use the multi-scrobbler project (github.com/foxxmd/multi-scrobbler) instead.

lastfmImportPlaycount.title: Import playcount from Last.fm
lastfmImportPlaycount.description: On a track's first observation, seed its playcount baseline from Last.fm (in addition to Navidrome's own playCount). Uses your Last.fm account playcounts.

incompleteAlbumMinTracks.title: Minimum tracks for a complete album
incompleteAlbumMinTracks.description: Albums with fewer tracks than this (when no MusicBrainz match exists) are routed to the Singles folder.

classifyFromMB.title: Prefer MusicBrainz for classification
classifyFromMB.description: Use MusicBrainz release type (Soundtrack/Compilation/Single) when an album matches; fall back to local tag heuristics otherwise.

readNfo.title: Read NFO sidecars (album.nfo / artist.nfo)
readNfo.description: Use Kodi-style NFO files to fill metadata the APIs can't provide (styles, moods, custom fields). Tags still take priority.

writeNfo.title: Write/update NFO sidecars after collecting metadata
writeNfo.description: Rewrite album.nfo / artist.nfo with the metadata gathered during a run.

backupBeforeWrite.title: Back up metadata before tag/NFO writes
backupBeforeWrite.description: Snapshot the track's tag values and original .nfo to plugin storage before editing, so a rollback can restore them. Metadata only - never copies audio files.

backupRetentionDays.title: Backup/report retention (days)
backupRetentionDays.description: Auto-prune old backups, reports and logs older than this. 0 = keep forever.

rollbackRetentionDays.title: Rollback data retention (days)
rollbackRetentionDays.description: How long apply records + file/nfo backups are kept so a run can be rolled back. After this, old runs are pruned to keep the database lean. 0 = keep forever.

folderSchema.title: Album folder schema
folderSchema.description: Path template for normal albums. Supported placeholders: {albumArtist} {album} {year} {genre} {mbid} {artist} {title}. '/' creates nested folders.

fileSchema.title: Track file schema
fileSchema.description: File name template (extension appended automatically). Placeholders: {track} {disc} {title} {artist} {album} {albumArtist} {year} {genre} {mbid}. Use {track:02}/{disc:02} for zero-padding.

renameSidecars.title: Rename sidecar files too
renameSidecars.description: Move .lrc/.jpg/.nfo files alongside renamed audio files.

pruneEmptyDirs.title: Delete empty source folders after moving
pruneEmptyDirs.description: After files are moved out of a folder, delete it if it becomes empty.

skipHiddenFiles.title: Skip hidden files/folders
skipHiddenFiles.description: Ignore files and folders whose name starts with a dot (hidden).

illegalCharReplacement.title: Illegal filename char replacement
illegalCharReplacement.description: Character used to replace characters that are illegal in filenames ( \ / : * ? " < > | ).

maxNameLength.title: Max file/folder name length
maxNameLength.description: Longest allowed generated file or folder name.

excludePaths.title: Exclude paths (never touch these)
excludePaths.description: Directory prefixes or "prefix/*" globs under the library root that are skipped entirely (e.g. ["inbox", "Downloads/*"]).

verifyIdentity.title: Verify identity before changing a track
verifyIdentity.description: Only change a track once its identity is confirmed - fingerprint, embedded tags and filenames all agree. Safer, but files with messy tags may be left in place.

minConfidence.title: Minimum identity confidence
minConfidence.description: How sure the identity check must be (0-1). A file scores higher with MusicBrainz IDs / ISRC, lower with none; an AcoustID fingerprint match adds partial confidence. Below this score a track is left unverified.

skipUnverified.title: Skip unverified tracks
skipUnverified.description: When on, files that fail identity verification are routed to the artist's Singles folder instead of being left in place. When off, unverified files are organized by their tag/folder metadata.

acoustidMode.title: AcoustID mode
acoustidMode.description: How AcoustID is used: 'fingerprint' fingerprints files and looks them up in the AcoustID database; 'lookup' uses existing fingerprints; 'disabled' turns it off.

acoustidUrl.title: AcoustID fingerprint sidecar URL
acoustidUrl.description: URL of the AcoustID Docker sidecar (acoustid/ in this repo). Pre-set to http://nd-organizer-acoustid:8097 (the shared-network container name) - only change it if your sidecar lives elsewhere. The sidecar fingerprints files so songs without an MBID/ISRC can be accurately paired to their album. Clear the field to skip AcoustID.

primarySource.title: Primary metadata source
primarySource.description: Which source wins when sources disagree: 'musicbrainz' (default), 'lidarr', or 'itunes'.

musicbrainzToken.title: MusicBrainz API token
musicbrainzToken.description: Optional. Raises the rate limit from ~1 to ~50 requests/sec.

lastfmApiKey.title: Last.fm API key
lastfmApiKey.description: Optional. Used for genres and user playcounts.

lastfmApiSecret.title: Last.fm API secret
lastfmApiSecret.description: Required for favorites sync (write methods need an API signature).

lastfmPassword.title: Last.fm password
lastfmPassword.description: Used once to obtain the session key for favorites sync.

lastfmUser.title: Last.fm username
lastfmUser.description: Used with lastfmApiKey to pull user playcounts and sync favorites.

favoritesSyncLastfm.title: Sync favorites with Last.fm (loved tracks)
favoritesSyncLastfm.description: The favorites-sync switch. When on: Navidrome stars become Last.fm loves and Last.fm loves become Navidrome stars (bidirectional). Needs lastfmApiKey + lastfmUser + lastfmApiSecret + lastfmPassword for the session.

favoritesSyncMax.title: Max favorites to sync per run
favoritesSyncMax.description: Maximum number of favorites to process per sync pass (a safety cap).

favoritesSyncBidirectional.title: Bidirectional favorites sync
favoritesSyncBidirectional.description: When on, unstar in Navidrome propagates to unlove on Last.fm and vice versa. When off, sync is additive-only (never removes). Enable if you want both sources to stay perfectly in sync.

genreFrom.title: Genre source
genreFrom.description: Where genres come from: 'musicbrainz', 'lastfm', or 'essentia' (ML audio analysis, requires essentiaUrl).

overwriteExistingTags.title: Overwrite existing tags
overwriteExistingTags.description: When false, only fill missing fields; existing values are kept.

writePlaycount.title: Write playback metadata to tracks (playcount, stars, loved)
writePlaycount.description: When enabled (and in apply mode), writes each track's playcount (FMPS_PLAYCOUNT), star rating (RATING, 0-5) and loved/favorite status (LOVED) into its tags. Opt-in - keeps your audio files self-describing for other players. Respects overwriteExistingTags.

embedArtwork.title: Embed artwork in audio files
embedArtwork.description: Download album art from the Cover Art Archive and embed it directly into each audio file's tags.

writeCoverJpg.title: Write cover.jpg sidecar
writeCoverJpg.description: Also save the album art as a cover.jpg in the album folder (Navidrome/Plex/Kodi pick it up on rescan).

overwriteArt.title: Replace existing artwork
overwriteArt.description: When false, existing embedded/sidecar art is kept if present.

artworkPriority.title: Artwork priority
artworkPriority.description: Which artwork to prefer when several exist, in priority order, e.g. 'coverartarchive', 'embedded', 'folder'.

artworkCd.title: Download CD art
artworkCd.description: Download CD / disc art when available.

artworkBooklet.title: Download booklet art
artworkBooklet.description: Download booklet / medium art when available.

downloadLyrics.title: Download lyrics files
downloadLyrics.description: Fetch synchronized lyrics from LRCLIB (lrclib.net) and save them next to each track.

lyricsFormat.title: Lyrics format
lyricsFormat.description: Lyrics file format: 'lrc' for synchronized lyrics, 'txt' for plain text.

lidarrUrl.title: Lidarr URL
lidarrUrl.description: Lidarr API URL. Default is http://lidarr:8686 (Docker container name). Empty disables Lidarr integration.

lidarrApiKey.title: Lidarr API key
lidarrApiKey.description: API key for the Lidarr instance above (Lidarr: Settings > General).

lidarrMode.title: Lidarr mode
lidarrMode.description: How to treat Lidarr-tracked artists: 'disabled' ignores Lidarr; 'metadataOnly' uses Lidarr metadata but the organizer still lays out the library; 'metadataPlusRescan' also asks Lidarr to refresh the artist after moves.

writeTagsForTracked.title: Write tags for Lidarr-tracked albums
writeTagsForTracked.description: Override: allow the plugin to write tags even for Lidarr-tracked albums. Off by default to avoid conflicting with Lidarr.

lidarrForceSearchIncomplete.title: Force-search incomplete albums in Lidarr
lidarrForceSearchIncomplete.description: When an album is missing tracks and the artist AND album are both monitored in Lidarr, trigger a Lidarr AlbumSearch so it downloads the missing tracks. Nothing is searched otherwise.

useLidarrNamingSchema.title: Use Lidarr's naming schema for folders/files
useLidarrNamingSchema.description: Use Lidarr's naming config (artistFolderFormat/albumFolderFormat/standardTrackFormat) instead of the organizer's folderSchema/fileSchema. Requires lidarrUrl + lidarrApiKey.

audiomuseUrl.title: AudioMuse-AI URL
audiomuseUrl.description: AudioMuse-AI instance URL. Default is http://audiomuse-ai-flask-app:8000 (Docker container name). Empty disables acoustic analysis.

audiomuseToken.title: AudioMuse-AI API token
audiomuseToken.description: API token for the AudioMuse-AI instance above, if it requires one (sent as a bearer token).

notifyAudiomuseAfterRun.title: Trigger AudioMuse-AI re-sync after renames
notifyAudiomuseAfterRun.description: After a run that moved files, ask AudioMuse-AI to re-run library analysis (POST /api/analysis/start) so its results stay valid for the new paths.

writeAcousticTags.title: Write acoustic tags (BPM/key/mood/energy)
writeAcousticTags.description: Write BPM/key/mood/energy tags into each track from AudioMuse-AI. NOTE: AudioMuse-AI exposes per-track acoustic features only through its in-process plugin API, not over HTTP - so this is skipped unless your instance (or an acoustic-tags plugin) exposes a per-track endpoint. Fails soft, never blocks a run.

scanUser.title: Scan user (optional)
scanUser.description: Optional. The plugin normally uses the user(s) granted in User Access automatically - only set this to force a specific user for rescans and playback stats.

triggerScanAfterRun.title: Rescan after each run
triggerScanAfterRun.description: Ask Navidrome to re-scan after a run finishes so changes appear immediately.

scanAfterAlbum.title: Rescan after each moved album
scanAfterAlbum.description: Instantly rescans so the player never calls old filenames.

scanAfterTagWrite.title: Rescan after tag-only writes
scanAfterTagWrite.description: Also ask Navidrome to re-scan after tag/NFO writes, not just after file moves.

scanDebounceSeconds.title: Scan debounce (seconds)
scanDebounceSeconds.description: Delay Navidrome rescans by this many seconds so a burst of changes coalesces into a single scan. 0 = rescan immediately after each change.

octoFiestaUrl.title: Octo-Fiesta proxy URL
octoFiestaUrl.description: Octo-Fiesta missing-track proxy URL. Default is http://octo-fiesta:8080 (Docker container name). The webhook dashboard reads this to probe health. Leave empty to hide the octo-fiesta card.

octoFiestaProvider.title: Octo-Fiesta provider
octoFiestaProvider.description: Display label for the provider octo-fiesta is configured with (SquidWTF, Deezer, Qobuz, Yandex). Shown on the dashboard card.

maxScanEntries.title: Max files scanned per pass
maxScanEntries.description: Cap on how many files one full-library scan indexes per run (0 = unlimited). When hit, the scan pauses and resumes where it stopped on the next run - useful for very large libraries. Chunking within a run is filesPerScanTask.

cleanupNoAudioFolders.title: Delete folders with no audio files
cleanupNoAudioFolders.description: After organizing, delete any library folder whose entire contents contain no audio files (only images, nfo, lyrics or other misc files). Handles empty folders AND folders left behind after moves. Apply mode only; dry-run reports what would be deleted. Never touches the library root or excluded paths.

parseFilenames.title: Parse filenames for tagless files
parseFilenames.description: When a file has no usable embedded tags, derive track number / artist / title from its filename (e.g. "01 - Artist - Title.flac") so tagless files still get organized.

autoTagFromMB.title: Auto-tag from MusicBrainz
autoTagFromMB.description: During a run, fetch the album's tracklist from MusicBrainz and fill each track's MISSING tag fields (title, artist, album, year, MusicBrainz recording/album IDs). Never overwrites existing values unless overwriteExistingTags is on. Apply mode only.

detectDuplicates.title: Detect duplicate audio files
detectDuplicates.description: Report files across the library that share an audio fingerprint (size + content sample) - possible duplicates. Report-only, nothing is moved.

writeReplayGain.title: Write ReplayGain loudness tags
writeReplayGain.description: Compute ReplayGain loudness with the acoustid sidecar's ffmpeg (EBU R128) and write REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_GAIN / REPLAYGAIN_TRACK_PEAK (and album tags in album mode). Requires ffmpeg in the acoustid image. Apply mode only.

replayGainMode.title: ReplayGain scope
replayGainMode.description: 'track' writes per-track gain/peak only. 'album' also writes REPLAYGAIN_ALBUM_GAIN (mean of track gains) and REPLAYGAIN_ALBUM_PEAK (loudest track peak) to every track in the album.

replayGainReference.title: ReplayGain reference (LUFS)
replayGainReference.description: Reference loudness in LUFS that a gain of 0 dB corresponds to. The ReplayGain standard is -18; lower values (e.g. -14) target louder playback.

metaGateEnabled.title: Skip runs when a metadata source is offline
metaGateEnabled.description: When a required external metadata source (AcoustID / MusicBrainz / Lidarr) is unreachable, skip the run and retry later instead of organizing on degraded metadata. Off = run best-effort anyway.

trimMissingDays.title: Trim missing files (days)
trimMissingDays.description: Every this many days, purge Navidrome's missing-files list (entries whose audio file is gone) via its native DELETE /missing API. 0 = disabled. Requires an admin account (navidromeAdminUser/Password below).

navidromeAdminUser.title: Navidrome admin user
navidromeAdminUser.description: Admin username used to call Navidrome's native API (purging missing files is admin-only). Leave empty to fall back to scanUser.

navidromeAdminPassword.title: Navidrome admin password
navidromeAdminPassword.description: Password for the admin user above, sent as HTTP Basic auth to Navidrome's native API. Stored in Navidrome's config store.

starIgnorePercent.title: Ignore listens under this %
starIgnorePercent.description: A listen that ends before this % of the track is ignored entirely - no skip penalty, no credit. A momentary tap that never really played shouldn't drag a rating down.

lovedThresholdStars.title: Loved = at least this many stars
lovedThresholdStars.description: Tracks rated at or above this star value are marked as loved/favorite (Navidrome star + LOVED tag).

ratingSyncWriteToLidarr.title: Push ratings to Lidarr
ratingSyncWriteToLidarr.description: Push computed star ratings (track + album) to Lidarr when publishing to Navidrome. Only works for Lidarr-tracked artists. Requires lidarrUrl + lidarrApiKey.

ratingSyncPullFromNavidrome.title: Pull ratings from Navidrome
ratingSyncPullFromNavidrome.description: Import star ratings from Navidrome (set via Subsonic clients) into the plugin DB on each stats pass. Useful when ratings were set manually in the UI.

listenbrainzScrobble.title: Scrobble to ListenBrainz
listenbrainzScrobble.description: Scrobble full listens (>= starFullPlayPercent) to ListenBrainz and push track/album/artist ratings. DUPLICATE WARNING: if Navidrome's own ListenBrainz scrobbler is also running, plays will be double-counted. Disable it before enabling this. RECOMMENDATION: enable BOTH lastfmScrobble AND listenbrainzScrobble for full coverage across both platforms. Uses the same token as musicbrainzToken (MusicBrainz ecosystem, same account). For deduplication across multiple sources, use multi-scrobbler (github.com/foxxmd/multi-scrobbler) instead.

essentiaUrl.title: Essentia analysis URL
essentiaUrl.description: Essentia genre/mood ML sidecar URL. Default is http://nd-organizer-essentia:8080 (Docker container name). Acts as fallback when AudioMuse is unreachable, or primary source when genreFrom=essentia.

discogsToken.title: Discogs personal access token
discogsToken.description: Discogs API token for fetching release credits (performers, producers, engineers) and community ratings. Get one at https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers

discogsCredits.title: Fetch credits from Discogs
discogsCredits.description: When enabled, fetches detailed release credits (who played what, produced, engineered) from Discogs and includes them in album.nfo files. Requires discogsToken.

theAudioDbKey.title: TheAudioDB API key
theAudioDbKey.description: TheAudioDB public API key for fetching fanart, artist bios, and album descriptions. Get a free key at https://www.theaudiodb.com/api

theAudioDbFanart.title: Fetch fanart from TheAudioDB
theAudioDbFanart.description: When enabled, fetches artist fanart (backgrounds, banners) and album art from TheAudioDB as additional artwork sources. Requires theAudioDbKey.

geniusToken.title: Genius API access token
geniusToken.description: Genius client access token for fetching lyrics, annotations, and artist backgrounds. Register at https://genius.com/api-clients

geniusLyrics.title: Fetch lyrics from Genius
geniusLyrics.description: When enabled, fetches song lyrics from Genius as a fallback when LRCLIB doesn't have them. Requires geniusToken.

useCommunityRatings.title: Use community ratings for seeding
useCommunityRatings.description: When enabled, community ratings from Discogs are used to seed initial star ratings. When disabled (default), only personal ratings from Lidarr and your own play/skip behavior are used. Ratings are always personal unless you enable this.

librefmUrl.title: Libre.fm URL
librefmUrl.description: Libre.fm scrobble server URL. Free, open-source alternative to Last.fm. Get an API key at https://libre.fm/api-keys.php

librefmSessionKey.title: Libre.fm session key
librefmSessionKey.description: Session key for Libre.fm scrobbling. Obtain from https://libre.fm/api-keys.php

librefmScrobble.title: Scrobble to Libre.fm
librefmScrobble.description: Scrobble full listens to Libre.fm. Free, open-source alternative to Last.fm. Keep OFF if you also scrobble to Last.fm (double-counting).

elements.text: Release metadata, classification and artwork links.
Fingerprint sidecar (Docker) - verifies songs without an MBID/ISRC so they can be paired to their album.
Identity verification uses this sidecar for files without a MusicBrainz ID/ISRC.

Genres, playcounts, star-rating scrobbles and favorites sync - all from your Last.fm account. TIP: enable BOTH lastfmScrobble AND listenbrainzScrobble for full coverage. If you use Navidrome's built-in scrobbler, disable it here to avoid double-counting. For dedup across multiple sources, use multi-scrobbler (github.com/foxxmd/multi-scrobbler).
Tracked-artist metadata, naming schema and force-search for incomplete monitored albums.
Acoustic tags (BPM/key/mood) and re-sync after renames.
Fetch detailed release credits (who played what, produced, engineered) and community ratings from Discogs. Enhances album.nfo files with rich metadata.
Fetch artist fanart (backgrounds, banners), album art, and artist biographies from TheAudioDB. Enhances the visual experience in media centers.
Fetch song lyrics from Genius as a fallback when LRCLIB doesn't have them. Also provides artist backgrounds and song annotations.

Playback filtering without touching files. The KEYWORD filter drops filler-keyword tracks from auto-queues (explicit searches still return them). The SKIP-CONTENT limiter controls how many skip-heavy (low-star) tracks may appear in queued lists: exclude entirely, a third, less than half, or half - or leave them alone (none). Deploy proxy/docker-compose.yml and set its URL below; settings are pushed to the proxy on every stats pass.

Derives a 0-5 star rating (half-star steps) from each listen's playback percentage. Rating + playcount live in the plugin's own storage (use persistenceBackend=mysql for durable external storage) and the rating is published to Navidrome via setRating - never written to the audio file. Full listens (>= full %) earn a star and +1 playcount; half listens (>= half %) earn 0.5; skips before the half mark are a -0.5 penalty; a full listen forgives one prior skip.
Scrobble to Libre.fm, a free open-source alternative to Last.fm. Uses the same Subsonic protocol. Get an API key at https://libre.fm/api-keys.php
The plugin cannot host a web page, so reports/status are POSTed to the nd-organizer webhook sidecar, which renders the dashboard at its URL.
Activity is tracked automatically: latest status/report live in the plugin KVStore and the Navidrome server log. Optionally push each run's report/status to a hosted log.

Octo-Fiesta (github.com/V1ck3s/octo-fiesta) is a third-party Subsonic proxy that serves songs your library doesn't have from a streaming provider. The webhook dashboard uses these to probe its health and show its activity.
Store the plugin's cache/state in your own MySQL/MariaDB instead of the Navidrome-managed SQLite. Deploy the mysql sidecar (mysql/docker-compose.yml) and enter your database connection here.
